description: Source code for the AssetCategory document in ERPNext, including validation methods for finance books, account types, account currency, and CWIP accounts, as well as a helper function to retrieve asset category accounts.

classes.name: AssetCategory
classes.description: Represents an asset category with validation logic for finance books, account types, account currency, and CWIP accounts.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs all validation checks on the AssetCategory instance.

methods.name: validate_finance_books
methods.description: Validates that finance book entries have positive depreciation counts and frequencies.

methods.name: validate_account_currency
methods.description: Ensures account currencies match the company's default currency.

methods.name: validate_account_types
methods.description: Checks that accounts have correct account types based on their designated fields.

methods.name: valide_cwip_account
methods.description: Validates presence of Capital Work in Progress accounts if CWIP accounting is enabled.
